question: Which of the following committees was associated with Industrial Licensing Policy Inquiry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dutt Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Dutt Committee** was associated with the Industrial Licensing Policy Inquiry.
 
• This committee was set up to examine the existing industrial licensing policy and suggest reforms to improve industrial growth and efficiency.
 
• The committee's recommendations played a significant role in shaping India's industrial policy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Industrial licensing in India was a mechanism to regulate the establishment and expansion of industries in the country.
 
• The licensing policy was initially introduced to ensure balanced regional development and to control monopolistic practices.
 
• Over time, the policy underwent several changes to liberalize the economy and promote private sector participation.
 
• The Dutt Committee's work was instrumental in identifying the challenges and opportunities in the industrial sector, leading to policy adjustments that facilitated economic growth.
